name: extrovert
description: A persistent, scoped inbox for coding agents, with reviewed outbound mail and native MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: A real inbox for your coding agent
interface.longDescription: Create and operate persistent agent inboxes, read and search mail, wait for OTPs and replies, and send through Extrovert's human Review Loop using native MCP tools.
defaultPrompt: Create an Extrovert account and connect this session.
Check my Extrovert inbox and summarize unread mail.
Draft an email and submit it for human review.
